correctness.rationale: On friendship graph with m>=3 triangles, unit hopping, off-diagonal dephasing g>0, peripheral population-loss rate 2 and initial peripheral in another triangle, dissipative Hilbert–Schmidt quadratic form makes the Lindblad generator strictly stable: zero real dissipation would force diagonal operator zero at trap and constant over connected edges, hence zero. Permutations of nondistinguished triangles and within-pair swaps leave 18 real Hermitian orbit coordinates. Each generator entry is affine in m; evaluating orbit bases at m=3,4 exactly reconstructs all m. Independently formed the exact symbolic 18x18 matrix and integrated trace rational N/D; SymPy confirms all coefficients of N,D and of (g+1)N-m^2 D/4 and N-m g D/4 are nonnegative in g,m-2, proving T>=m^2/[4(g+1)] and T>=mg/4. Exact scaling g=z sqrt(m) gives F(z)=2(z^2+1)(z^2+2)/(z(3z^2+4)). Coercive bounds exclude optimizing z->0 or infinity; unique positive root of 3z^6+3z^4-6z^2-8 gives z*=1.226929487... and F(z*)=1.681019855... . Independent full (2m+1)^2 complex Liouvillian solves at m=3..6, g=0.5,1,3 agree with reduced mean in 12 tests. No extrapolation replaces the exact symbolic identity.
